decision: Formal Warning for the Driver Formal Warning for the Team.
fact: Car 1 overtook several cars in the Fast Lane whilst traversing the Working Lane to the Practice Start Area
offence: Breach of Article 12.2.1 i) of the International Sporting Code and non-compliance with Race Director's Event Note (item 11, document 22).
penalty: Formal Warning for the Driver Formal Warning for the Team.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 1 (Max Verstappen), the team representative and reviewed video evidence. Car 1 overtook a significant number of cars whilst traversing the Working Lane en route to the practice start area, after having momentarily been in the Fast Lane. The Stewards note that the driver of Car 1 did perform a genuine practice start and rejoined after all cars in the Fast Lane had passed. In relation to the general subject of overtaking in the pit lane, the fact that a warning was issued for the 4 cases this weekend is not to be taken as a precedent and the Stewards note that future breaches of pit lane procedures may involve a sporting penalty.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 1 Failure To Follow Race Directors Instructions
